_notes: Task prompts consolidated and de-duplicated from teaching notes across multiple students. These are short, formulaic IELTS-style task instructions (not long-form creative writing), so they are reused as-is rather than rewritten — unlike the Reading passages, there is no separate 'question' to redesign here.

task1_academic.prompt: The diagram shows the process by which milk and related products are produced.

steps: Cows graze in the field
Milking machine collects milk (twice a day)
Raw milk moved to refrigerated storage
Milk tanker delivers milk to the dairy daily
Split: some milk made into cheese, cream and butter
Remainder pasteurised and packaged as bottled milk
Products distributed to supermarkets, shops and convenience stores

The diagram below shows how geothermal energy is used to produce electricity.

steps: Cold water is pumped down the injection well, 4.5km underground
The water passes through the geothermal zone of hot rocks and is heated
Hot water is pumped back up through the production well
The hot water/steam passes into the condenser
Steam drives the turbine, which powers the generator to produce electricity
Electricity is transmitted via pylons to homes and businesses

steps: Tomatoes are picked and put in baskets
Good and bad tomatoes are sorted
Tomatoes are sent to the factory by truck
Talk, seeds and skin are removed
Sorted tomatoes are collected in a container
Tomatoes are crushed
Sugar, vinegar and salt are added
Mixture is boiled

Ketchup is poured into containers
Bottles are labelled
Bottles go through quality control

task1_academic.prompt: The diagram below shows how recycled paper is made. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

steps: Used paper is collected and moved along a conveyor belt to make pulp
Water and chemicals are added to break the paper down into pulp
The pulp is filtered to remove ink, separating cleaned pulp from ink and unfiltered pulp
The pulp is cleaned using air, water and soap
Water and chemicals are added again, and heated rollers press the pulp into sheets on a conveyor belt
The finished recycled paper is produced

steps: Week 1: Eggs are laid

Week 3: Second larval stage
Week 4: Third larval stage
Week 5: Fourth larval stage
Week 6: Pupal stage
Weeks 7-8: Adult mosquito emerges (the female mosquito's total lifespan is 6 to 8 weeks)

The diagrams below show the life cycle of the silkworm and the stages in the production of silk cloth. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

steps: Life cycle: an egg hatches into a silkworm larva after about 10 days
The larva feeds on mulberry leaves for 4-6 weeks
The larva spins itself into a cocoon of silk thread over 3-8 days
After about 16 days inside the cocoon, the silkworm emerges as a moth, which lays new eggs
Silk production: cocoons are selected
Cocoons are boiled in water to loosen the silk thread
The thread (300-900m long per cocoon) is unwound
Threads from several cocoons are twisted together
The twisted thread is dyed and woven into silk cloth

education: Some believe secondary students should learn international news as a subject at school, while others think it's a waste of time. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Schools should use films, computers and games instead of books. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some argue that teachers should focus on academics more than motivating students. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Discipline is an ever increasing problem in modern schools. Some people think that discipline should be the responsibility of teachers, while others think that this is the role of parents. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Some educators believe smaller class sizes improve learning outcomes, while others argue teacher quality matters more. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Some people think that parents should teach their children how to be good members of society. Others believe that school is the best place to learn this. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people say History is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that subjects like Science and Technology are more important than History. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Some people believe that children should not be allowed to use smartphones until they become teenagers. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe online education is more effective than traditional classroom learning, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people think that the government should provide free education to students in university. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people say that television is useful for education, while others say it is useful only for entertainment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Some people believe that studying at university or college is the best route to a successful career, while others believe that it is better to get a job straight after school. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Many university students want to learn about different subjects in addition to their main subjects. Others feel it is important to give all their time and attention to studying for their qualification. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
environment: Individuals can do nothing to improve the environment; only governments and large companies can make a difference. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

The government should reduce the amount of money spent on local environmental problems and instead increase funding into more urgent and threatening issues such as global warming. Please compose a 200-250 word essay discussing the related issue.

Some people believe that governments should limit the amount of water people can use, while others argue that individuals should be free to use as much water as they want. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Some people feel that manufacturers and supermarkets have the responsibility to reduce the amount of packaging of goods. Others argue that customers should avoid buying goods with a lot of packaging. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people believe that humans do not need to protect animals. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
society_government: Should countries be required to return cultural relics that were taken from other countries in the past? To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think all lawbreakers should be sent to prison, while others think there are better alternatives for those whose crimes are minor, such as making them do work for the local community. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

In many countries, a small number of people earn extremely high salaries. Some people believe this is good for the country, but others think governments should not allow salaries above a certain level. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Governments should spend money on railways rather than roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
Some people think that mobile phones should be banned in public places such as libraries, shops, and on public transport. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

In many countries women no longer feel the need to get married. Some people believe this is because women are able to earn their own income and therefore do not require the financial security that marriage can bring. To what extent do you agree?
With the development of modern society comes the loss of traditional ways of life. Is it important to keep our traditional ways of life? How can this be achieved?
Some believe that the government should support artists like musicians, painters, and poets, while others argue that this is a misuse of funds. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of giving international aid to poor countries.
In the last few decades, more and more people are being hounded by the press. Some people think that famous people in the media should have no right to privacy. To what extent do you agree?
Some people believe that large companies should provide social and sports facilities for the local community. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Cities should be designed to be attractive for local and foreign tourists. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
In many societies, there is a growing emphasis on individualism, with people prioritising their personal goals and desires over collective interests. Is this a positive or negative development?
Living in a country where you have to speak a foreign language can cause serious social problems, as well as practical problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
In some countries, more and more people are becoming interested in finding out about the history of the house or building they live in. What are the reasons for this? How can people research this?

Rich countries often give money to poorer countries, but it does not solve poverty. Therefore, developed countries should give other types of help to the poor countries rather than financial aid. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

In some countries, many people suffer from health problems due to eating too much fast food. It is, therefore, necessary for governments to impose a higher tax on this kind of food. Do you agree or disagree?

Nowadays, most countries can improve the standard of living through economic development, but some social values are lost as a result. Do you think the advantages of this phenomenon outweigh the disadvantages?
Nowadays, celebrities are more famous for their glamour and wealth than for their achievements, and this has set a bad example for young children. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
The average standard of people's health is likely to be lower in the future than it is now. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

Some people say that the main environmental problem of our time is the loss of particular species of plants and animals. Others say that there are more important environmental problems. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
In some cultures, children are often told that they can achieve anything if they try hard enough. What are the advantages and disadvantages of giving children this message?
One problem faced by almost every large city is traffic congestion. What do you think the causes are? What solutions can you suggest?
In some countries owning a home rather than renting one is very important for people. Why might this be the case? Do you think this is a positive or negative situation?
work_economy: Some people think that job satisfaction is more important than job security, while others think a permanent job is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Interviews form the basic selecting criteria for most large companies. However, some people think that the interview is not a reliable method of choosing whom to employ. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think that competition at work, at school and in daily life is a good thing. Others believe that we should try to cooperate more, rather than competing against each other. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Some people believe that young people should choose the jobs that they want, but other people think they should be more realistic and think more about their future. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
In many countries, young people change jobs every few years. What are the reasons for this? Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Some people believe that employers should not be concerned about the way their employees dress, but should focus on the quality of their work. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Employers should give their staff at least a 4-week holiday a year to make employees better at their jobs. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

The working week should be shorter and workers should have a longer weekend. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
Whether or not someone achieves their aims is mostly a question of luck. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people believe that professionals, such as doctors and engineers, should be required to work in the country where they did their training. Others believe that they should be free to work in another country if they wish. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
It is important for people to take risks, both in their professional lives and their personal lives. Do you think the advantages of taking risks outweigh the disadvantages?
media_technology: Some believe technology makes communication easier, while others think it harms real relationships. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
In many countries, people are increasingly choosing international food over traditional local food, and some believe this is a negative development. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think news has no connection to people's lives, so it is a waste of time to read newspapers or watch television news programs. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think that zoos are cruel and should be closed down. Others believe zoos can be useful in protecting wild animals. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Some people think that family is the most important influence on young adults. Others believe that friends have a greater influence. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
The most important aim of science should be to improve people's lives. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people believe that it is best to accept a bad situation, such as an unsatisfactory job or shortage of money. Others argue that it is better to try and improve such situations. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Some people think that it is more beneficial to take part in sports which are played in teams, like football, while other people think that taking part in individual sports, like tennis or swimming, is better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
